videos.title: Client paid late? The 4 emails to send, and when #shorts
videos.caption:
Client paid late again? Here is what to send, and when:

1. Same day: send the invoice with a due date
2. 1–3 days late: a friendly nudge
3. About 10 days late: ask for a payment date
4. 3+ weeks late: a calm final notice
5. Let your tracker count the late days

Save this for the next late client, and send it to a freelancer friend who needs it.

Freelancer Client OS is a Notion template with invoices that count their late days and 8 client emails ready to send.

videos.title: Why your freelance quotes get ignored (5 fixes) #shorts
videos.caption:
Why your quotes get ignored (and what to do instead):

1. You send it and wait: follow up after 3 days, then a week later
2. No expiry date: add a “valid until” date
3. Your price is a guess: check hours × your rate
4. You never ask why you lost
5. Your pipeline lives in your head

Save this before your next quote, and send it to a freelancer friend.
